recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce obsolete constrainedType/base wording; future cleanups to abbreviated narrative examples should be handled under a current editorial tracker rather than as unresolved FHIR-8541 application work.
issue_request: FHIR-8541 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition change request from DSTU1 asking how to interpret StructureDefinition differentials: how to find the parent/base StructureDefinition and how to distinguish extending/specializing from constraining when deriving a snapshot.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6305. In the imported git history, the same timestamp/revision appears as 1e53085b019b2d2898f52d58e61b8c3e7f39f731, whose commit subject mentions FHIR-8539 but whose patch corrects the StructureDefinition base/constrainedType invariants and element.base rule that FHIR-8541 discusses. Earlier FHIR-6079 established the then-current kind/constrainedType/base model and narrative for the same StructureDefinition usage problem.
additional_context: The old DSTU1 constrainedType/base representation was later replaced by the current type/baseDefinition/derivation model through FHIR-8916 and git commit 98cfb6ddcb8341506ecc536dd33625f5424e03ff. Current build-scope source lists StructureDefinition as an active conformance resource and normative package member. In the current resource definition, baseDefinition names the parent structure, derivation records specialization versus constraint, differential is defined relative to the base StructureDefinition, and the StructureDefinition notes describe differential inheritance/ordering and route constrained types to the profiling rules. No Zulip or Confluence record was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current source already preserves the substance of FHIR-8541 under the modern element names and supplies the differential interpretation needed to regenerate or understand snapshots from a base StructureDefinition.
